messages:
jordan: night scan flagged CVE-2026-0587 in parsersafe (unsafe deserialization). tagging eng-security. :rotating_light:
sec-bot: Dependency scan result: parsersafe@1.7.0 -> CVE-2026-0587 (unsafe deserialization leading to possible remote code execution). NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-0587
priya: Quick inventory: which builds include parsersafe? I know model-upload, ingest-service, and the offline-embedder.
samir: Confirmed transitive via ingest-core -> model-uploader -> parsersafe. Affects hosted and Dedicated model-upload paths. Private only if model-upload is enabled on their cluster.
lee: Is there an upstream fix?
jordan: upstream released 1.7.2 with deserialization guard and input schema checks. No API break.
priya: Risk assessment: impact = high (RCE), exploitability = medium (requires crafted upload), exposure = public upload endpoint. Recommend P1 emergency patch.
ajay: P1 agreed. Who takes triage?
priya: I'll own triage, samir take the fix branch, lee coordinate release and customer comms, devops-oncall handle rollout and KMS/audit.
samir: I'll create an emergency branch to bump parsersafe -> 1.7.2, add a regression test with the NVD proof-of-concept payload, run CI against serializer fixtures and upload integration tests. Will prepare a canary image.
devops-oncall: Rollout checklist: need RBAC approval for deployment to prod image-stream. Which group signs RBAC deltas?
lee: Standard is infra-lead + product-security reviewer. For P1 we can use expedited flow: infra-lead + on-call security reviewer. I'll DM infra lead for sign-off.
priya: Add compliance items: every signed image must include a cosign signature and the KMS audit entry must be captured and archived. Compliance requires immutable logs for the patch window.
jordan: We sign artifacts with redwood-release-key. Security says no immediate rotation needed but must log usage and attach signature hash to release.
samir: Example sign command we will use:
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/redwood-release-key gcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-202603-176500
```
devops-oncall: Confirmed: KMS audit retention is 180 days for release keys. I'll enable extra alerting for policy changes during rollout and export the key usage logs to secure-bucket.
priya: Drafting triage runbook entry now: repro steps, PoC test input, mitigations (reject unknown mime-types, small-file limits, rate-limit uploads), verification checklist (unit + integration + fuzz tests), rollout plan (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%), rollback criteria (>=0.5% error rate OR JVM exception spike OR sustained latency >2x), communication templates.
jordan: Add RBAC sign-off matrix to the runbook: who approves deploy roles, who authorizes key access, where approvals are recorded.
lee: Also require audit logging for deployment and for the cosign operation. devops-oncall, can you ensure the deploy pipeline attaches the cosign signature hash to the deployment metadata?
devops-oncall: Yes. We'll add a metadata field signature_sha and store the KMS audit log id in deploy metadata. I'll also create a Grafana panel for upload-related error spikes and a PagerDuty rule for anomalies during the patch window.
samir: Opening PR with bump + regression test + signed canary image tag. Will attach CI run and cosign signature.
priya: Who will compose the customer advisory for hosted and the private-deploy mitigation steps?
lee: I'll draft the advisory and coordinate with product comms. It should include the CVE number, affected endpoints, remediation timeline, and recommended actions for private customers (apply patch + rotate ingestion keys if desired).
ajay: Escalation path if canary detects issues: infra-oncall -> priya -> security lead -> eng-vp. Update PagerDuty.
samir: Canary deployed at 5%: tag gcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-202603-176500-01. Reporting back in 15m.
devops-oncall: Canary metrics: latency +1.2%, no errors in first 10 min. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/parse-canary
jordan: Keep P1 until 100% verified. Any blockers on RBAC or approvals?
lee: Infra lead DM approval received. priya to sign in approvals tool after CI green.
priya: Approved in OneApprove now. :white_check_mark:
samir: Rolling to 25% now.
devops-oncall: Deploy event recorded. KMS key used: redwood-release-key. Audit log id: KMS-202603-176500-01. Logs exported.
samir: 100% rollout completed. Smoke tests & e2e pass. No anomalies detected.
jordan: Post-deploy tasks: merge emergency branch, backport patch to supported LTS branches, update triage runbook with timeline/owners, publish customer advisory and release notes, and close the P1.
lee: I'll publish release notes and post the advisory to status.redwood.com and notify account teams for Dedicated customers.
priya: I'll add a permanent runbook snippet under security/playbooks/vuln-response: ownership mapping, RBAC approval flow, KMS logging checklist, rollback criteria, and a communication template.
ajay: Good job. Mark this incident resolved after docs and backports.
security-audit-bot: This conversation will be archived to security/triage/CVE-2026-0587 when incident is closed.
jordan: Closing once runbook snippet and release notes are live. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
